--- a/toolformer_filter.py
+++ b/toolformer_filter.py
@@ -13,4 +13,31 @@
 ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
 
-    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
+    # Validate inputs
+    for arr in [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]:
+        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
+            raise ValueError("All inputs must be NumPy arrays")
+        if arr.ndim != 2:
+            raise ValueError("All inputs must be 2-dimensional")
+        if arr.size == 0:
+            raise ValueError("Inputs must not be empty")
+        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
+            raise ValueError("All array values must be finite")
+        if np.any(arr > 0):
+            raise ValueError("All array values must be nonpositive")
+    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
+        raise ValueError("All input arrays must have the same shape")
+    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
+        raise ValueError("Threshold must not be a boolean")
+    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
+        raise ValueError("Threshold must be finite and nonnegative")
+
+    # Compute per-candidate losses (negative sum of log probabilities)
+    loss_with = -np.sum(logp_with_result, axis=1)
+    loss_call = -np.sum(logp_call_only, axis=1)
+    loss_no = -np.sum(logp_no_call, axis=1)
+
+    # Margin: improvement over no-call baseline, taking the better of the two call scenarios
+    margins = loss_no - np.minimum(loss_with, loss_call)
+    keep = margins > tau_filter
+    return keep, margins
